create.name: Deborah King
create.bio:
Deborah King is an energy-healing teacher and author whose path changed direction in her twenties, when she was practising as a lawyer and a serious illness sent her looking beyond conventional answers. In the decades since, she has studied with healers and spiritual teachers from many traditions, kept up a daily Vedic meditation practice, and shaped her own approach, LifeForce Energy Healing, which she now passes on through a school with several levels of certification and a team of senior practitioners.

Her Hay House books, among them Be Your Own Shaman and Entangled in Darkness, combine her own story with practical exercises for sensing the subtle body, working with the chakras and trusting intuition. Most of her teaching takes place online: recorded courses on meditation, the chakras, forgiveness and self-love, live broadcasts on her YouTube channel, and courses with The Shift Network. She also offers private sessions from Santa Barbara, California, and leads LifeForce retreats with her teaching team. At Kripalu she teaches by video link while her senior teachers lead the practice and hands-on table work in the room.

books.title: Be Your Own Shaman: Heal Yourself and Others with 21st-Century Energy Medicine
books.author: Deborah King
books.description: Deborah's guide to energy work, drawing on her years of study with healers around the world. It explains the chakras and the layers of the energy field and offers exercises for grounding, clearing and sensing energy in everyday life.

courses.title: Renew, Restore, Reconnect: Energy Healing Reimagined
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, where Deborah teaches live by video and senior LifeForce teachers guide the room. Guided meditations, energy-awareness practices and partnered table work explore how energy moves through the body and field, for newcomers and experienced practitioners alike.

courses.title: LifeForce Energy Healing® Vedic Meditation
courses.description: A seven-part recorded video programme in which Deborah teaches the mantra-based meditation she has practised for decades. It covers the background of the practice, how to sit and use a mantra, and how to keep a daily routine going.

courses.title: LifeForce Energy Healing® Chakra Wisdom Course
courses.description: An eight-lesson on-demand course on the seven main chakras and the energy centres above the body. Deborah explains what each centre relates to and teaches a full-body chakra card reading.

courses.title: LifeForce Energy Healing® Highlights of Hallowed Retreat Video Series
courses.description: Around ten hours of recordings from a live retreat Deborah led in Ojai, California. It includes teachings, guided meditations, demonstrations of hands-on energy work and talks on death and conscious dying.

courses.title: LifeForce Energy Healing® Loving Yourself Audio Workshop
courses.description: A recorded audio workshop on self-love and what gets in its way. Deborah talks through shame, guilt and regret and guides listeners in practices for treating themselves with more kindness.

courses.title: LifeForce Energy Healing® Forgiveness: Letting Go of the Past Audio Workshop
courses.description: An audio workshop paired with a guided meditation on forgiveness, starting with forgiving oneself. Deborah explains how old guilt sits in the energy field and how to release it and set clearer boundaries.
